name: Sarcoid (Sarcoidosis, Neurosarcoidosis, Cardiac Sarcoid)

category.name: Lungs and Chest

what_to_bring: Complete Blood Count (CBC),
Complete Metabolic Panel (CMP),
Serum Calcium, and
Urinalysis.

Detailed clinical progress note^ (within the past 90 days) from a board-certified Pulmonologist, Rheumatologist or Internist , to include systems affected and physical exam emphasizing lung, heart, liver, spleen, and skin. Include a thorough neurological examination. Identify the current stage of pulmonary sarcoidosis, if present.
Labs^
Chest X-ray report^ and most recent chest CT report (if performed)
Pathology reports from all biopsies to confirm sarcoidosis diagnosis
Tuberculosis (TB) testing if pulmonary sarcoidosis present.
Pulmonary Function Test (PFT) to include flow volume loops, spirometry, lung volumes, and DLCO^.
6-minute walk test^
Eye evaluation by an ophthalmologist^
12-lead ECG^
Cardiac monitoring study of at least 24 hours, such as Holter monitor^
Most recent brain MRI with contrast
All items in Row B
Include any information that supports disease stability.
Items specified for cardiac or neurological sarcoidosis below.
Detailed clinical progress note from a board-certified Cardiologist (within the past 90 days)
Report from the most recent echocardiogram
Report from the most recent Cardiac MRI
Cardiac monitoring study (event monitor) of at least 30 days
Neurological Evaluation per FAA specifications (within past 90 days)
Brain MRI with contrast since initial diagnosis or most recent brain MRI if new symptoms have developed since last evaluation
All neuroimaging on CD in DICOM format
Lumbar puncture results (if performed)
